stoppedAt.description: where the procedure ended — distinguishes a legitimate early exit from a check that simply did not run

basis.description: ONE sentence: what you examined and why it did or did not clear the overlap bar. This is the result-level justification; it never licenses prose inside overlaps[].

obsidianOpened.description: true ONLY if you consulted Worklog.md itself — Read, or Grep with -C context against that path. A repo search, or reasoning from the titles mirror alone, is false.

shortlisted.description: titles carried out of the index scan, BEFORE verification — the audit trail that makes an empty result falsifiable

overlaps.description: Empty when nothing genuinely overlaps — that is the expected common case.

domain.description: the '## <domain>' heading the item sits under

why.description: one or two sentences naming the shared surface (file, type, .tres, design decision)
